correctness.rationale: Domination gives an exponential gap between the least singular direction and the remaining n−1 directions, so the extremal line is uniformly approximated by simple finite-time singular lines. A backward projective graph transform on Hom(L,H) is uniformly contracting; local holomorphic iterates converge to a holomorphic invariant line on a thin strip. Once the invariant object is a holomorphic line, the charge normalization and the two scalar Diophantine cohomology equations are ambient-rank independent. Vanishing Chern and winding then constructs a nonzero analytic eigensection directly, while either obstruction prevents one. Comparing any two carried eigensections reduces to a scalar torus-translation eigenfunction, giving the exact character coset and one-dimensional eigenspaces. Reverse domination follows by the inverse cocycle.

originality.rationale: Azimifard's accessible primary abstract states the arbitrary-rank Chern obstruction under a phase-coboundary condition and the automatic exact Chern–winding criterion only in rank two under analytic domination. The audited theorem supplies an arbitrary-rank automatic discharge for an extremal one-dimensional dominated block by a higher-dimensional projective graph transform. Bochi–Gourmelon gives the necessary domination machinery but no sewn-bundle Chern/winding eigensection theorem, while Duarte–Klein concerns topological obstruction to domination itself. No independent Resultary theorem covers the conjunction. Full same-paper comparison is access-limited and retained as a residual risk.

Showing that every extremal one-dimensional dominated block in arbitrary rank inherits the exact criterion is a substantive analytic extension with a reusable higher-rank graph-transform lemma, while carefully avoiding claims about the complementary block.

final_claim: For an analytic sewn quasiperiodic cocycle of any fiber rank at least three, an extremal one-dimensional block of a uniform two-block dominated splitting carries a measurable eigensection exactly when its first Chern class and multiplier winding both vanish; then the carried eigenvalues form the stated dense circle coset and every carried eigensection is analytic up to scalar character.
limitations: Only a one-dimensional extremal dominated block, strip analyticity, invertibility and a Diophantine two-torus translation are covered.
No classification of eigensections carried by H or nonuniform/Liouville regimes.
